title: Enhance on a reference-to-video op with nothing attached uses the text-to-video rules
description: Found by MPI-1060's recipe sweeps (2026-10-11). With no reference staged, the r2v enhancer modes still invent a reference tag: LTX 2.3 r2v writes a <Picture 1> line in 11 of 15 runs, Wan 3.0 r2v writes <Image 1> in its directed tier (its validation.md open case). Prompt wording did not fix it on the 12B enhancer. Root fix in the enhance path: when an r2v mode is resolved and the references list is empty, use the recipe's t2v mode (nothing to reference = text to video). See brief.md.
